tools.label: Series
tools.title: Dropper series
tools.desc: Aise tools jo aap sirf file drop karke use karte ho. Jo karna hai uske hisaab se chunein aur turant shuru karein.
tool1.name: Event Dropper
tool1.desc: Bas event document (PDF ya image) drop karo, aur date aur venue Google Calendar mein automatic add ho jaate hain. Extracted details se WhatsApp/SNS announcement bhi ek tap mein ban jaata hai. Kisi bhi event ke liye.
tool1.attendDesc: Members ke jawab jama karke ginta hai. Padhe hue event se bhi shuru kar sakte hain, aur bina kisi document ke akele bhi. Members roster se apna naam chunte hain aur yes / maybe / no tap karte hain - na app, na sign-up.
tool1.attendPass: Naam, date, venue saath jaate hain
tool1.attendNote: Ise pehli screen ke “🙋 Sirf attendance jama karein” se shuru karein. Abhi preview hai, isliye screens aur steps badal sakte hain.
tool2.name: Schedule Dropper
tool2.desc: Ek sheet drop karein — year planner, fixture list, ya season calendar — aur usme likhi saari entries ek saath padh li jaati hain. List check karke sab ek saath Google Calendar mein add karein. Calendar-grid layout bhi chalta hai.
picker.title: Kaunsa Dropper use karna hai?
picker.t2line: Ek sheet se kai entries ek saath
placeholder.name: Agla Dropper jald aa raha hai
placeholder.desc: Naye drop-to-use tools hum dheere-dheere add karte rahenge. Release tak intezaar karein.
policy.label: Notes
policy.title: Shuru karne se pehle
policy.desc: Sabhi tools free hain, taaki koi bhi bina soche try kar sake. Iske badle, shuru karne se pehle ye baatein dhyan mein rakhein.
policy.p1desc: Har tool free mein publish kiya gaya hai. Sirf wahi chunein jo chahiye.
policy.p2desc: Tools free hone ke kaaran, hum one-on-one support nahi dete. Use kaise karna hai, har tool ki guide dekhein.
policy.p3desc: Support nahi hai, lekin tools ko time-time par improve kiya jata hai, aur nayi jaankari tool se automatic aapko milti hai.
about.label: About
about.title: Dropper kya hai
about.desc: “Bas file drop karo, aur jhanjhat khatam.” In chote tools ko hum Dropper kehte hain, aur ek series ke roop mein banate aur release karte hain. Abhi teen hain. Ek event document padhta hai, date aur venue Google Calendar mein daalta hai, aur WhatsApp/SNS announcement bhi bana deta hai. Doosra ek hi sheet padhta hai jisme bahut saari dates hoti hain — jaise year planner — aur un sab ko ek saath calendar mein daal deta hai. Teesra tournament entry form mein club roster se date of birth, age aur address bhar deta hai (Japanese forms ke liye bana hai). Sab same tarah kaam karte hain — bas drop — isliye sirf kisi khaas group ya sport ke liye nahi, koi bhi use kar sakta hai.
about.desc2: Inke saath Attendance bhi hai. Baaki tools ek kaagaz se kuch nikaalte hain; yeh logon se jama karta hai. Direction ulti hai, isliye yeh apne alag shelf par hai. Members roster se apna naam chunte hain aur yes, maybe ya no tap karte hain — na app, na sign-up, na login. Ise padhe hue event se bhi shuru kar sakte hain, aur bina kisi document ke akele bhi. Aur tools time ke saath add honge.
privacy.metaDesc: DROPPER ki privacy policy. Aapka data kaise handle hota hai, Google user data ka access, aur AI feature use karne par kya bheja jaata hai.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: DROPPER aapke browser mein chalta hai. Event, Schedule aur Entry Forms ke liye hum aapka data kabhi collect, store ya transmit nahi karte. Attendance tool akela exception hai - uska data hum rakhte hain (uska alag section dekhein).
privacy.s1operator: Operator: 重吉　哲弥 (independent developer)
privacy.s2body: Event, Schedule aur Entry Forms poori tarah aapke browser mein chalte hain. Padha hua kuch bhi hamare server par nahi jaata; sab kuch aapke apne Google account ke andar hota hai. Attendance tool exception hai - woh data hum rakhte hain (neeche uska alag section hai).
privacy.s3title: 3. Google user data kaise handle hota hai
privacy.s3body: Aapki permission se, DROPPER neeche diye gaye scopes ke andar Google services access karta hai.
privacy.s3r1a:
Google Calendar events banana aur edit karna
(calendar.events)
privacy.s3r1b: Aapke event document ya schedule se padhi gayi dates ko aapke apne calendar mein add karne ke liye.
privacy.s3r2a:
Is app ki banayi files ka access
(drive.file)
privacy.s3r2b: Event document ya schedule ka text padhne (OCR) aur usse aapke apne Google Drive mein save karne ke liye.
privacy.s3r3b: Yaad rakhne ke liye ki files kis folder mein save hoti hain, taaki aapke alag-alag devices (phone, computer) par wahi folder use ho.
privacy.s3n1: Ye saara data aapke apne Google account ke andar process hota hai. Hum ismein se kuch bhi receive nahi karte.
privacy.s3n2: drive.file sirf un files tak limited hai jo ye app khud banata hai. Ye aapki baaki Google Drive nahi dekh sakta.
privacy.s3n3: Text recognition (OCR) ke liye banayi gayi temporary files, text padhte hi turant delete kar di jaati hain.
privacy.s3n4: In scopes ke liye Dropper ne Google ka review (OAuth verification) pass kiya hai — July 2026 mein approve hua.
privacy.s4notice: AI feature use karne par, aapki drop ki hui event document ya schedule ki file (PDF ya image) jaisi hai waisi hamare relay server se hokar OpenAI (USA) ke AI ko bheji jaati hai. Ye feature use karna hai ya nahi, ye poori tarah aapki choice hai.
privacy.s4n1: AI use karna opt-in hai. Sign in ke baad ek dialog aapse "AI use karein" ya "AI use na karein" chunne ko kehta hai.
privacy.s4n2: Sirf tab jab aap "AI use karein" chunte hain, file (image ho to chhoti karke) hamare relay server (Cloudflare Workers) se hokar OpenAI ke API ko bheji jaati hai. API key hum dete hain; aapko key daalne ki zaroorat nahin. Relay server na file save karta hai na AI ka jawab.
privacy.s4n3: Apna kharcha ek tay seema mein rakhne ke liye hum OpenAI ka free hissa use karte hain, jo is shart par milta hai ki OpenAI bheja gaya content apne AI ko behtar banane mein use kar sakta hai. Isliye bheji gayi files OpenAI apne AI ko behtar banane mein use kar sakta hai. Personal information wale documents use na karein.
privacy.s4n4: Google user data (Google Drive ka padha hua text, aur aapke Google Calendar ya Drive ka content) AI ko kabhi nahi bheja jaata. Sirf wahi file bheji jaati hai jo aapne apne device se drop ki.
privacy.s4n5: Zyada use rokne ke liye, relay server sirf us din ka use aur connection ki jaankari ko chhota karke banaye gaye (wapas na badle ja sakne wale) nishan ke hisaab se ginti rakhta hai, aur agle din mita deta hai (ek vyakti din mein 20 event files aur 10 schedules tak).
privacy.s4n6: Agar aap "AI use na karein" chunte hain, to AI ko kuch bhi nahi bheja jaata.
privacy.s5body: DROPPER aapke Google user data ko hamare ya kisi third party ko na bechta hai, na share karta hai, na transfer karta hai. Google user data hum tak pahunchta hi nahi. Attendance tool ka data bhi kisi third party ko na becha jaata hai, na share kiya jaata hai.
privacy.s5n1: Sirf ek exception hai — jab aap "Use AI" choose karte hain. Tabhi aapki drop ki hui file (PDF ya image) hamare relay server se hokar OpenAI ke API ko bheji jaati hai (section 4). Tab bhi Google user data AI ko nahi bheja jaata.
privacy.s5n2: OpenAI ko bheje gaye data ka handling OpenAI ki Privacy Policy ke according hota hai.
privacy.s5n3: Iske alawa, hum Google user data kisi bhi advertiser, analytics provider ya third party ko kabhi disclose nahi karte.
privacy.s6body: DROPPER aapke data ko protect karne ke liye yeh mechanisms use karta hai:
privacy.s7body: Attendance tool ke alawa teen tools ka data hum store nahi karte, isliye aapka koi Google user data hamare paas nahi rehta. Sirf yeh information aapke device (browser ke localStorage) mein store hoti hai, aur hum use access nahi kar sakte:
privacy.s8body: DROPPER free hai, aur hum koi payment information collect ya store nahi karte. Agar ye policy badalti hai, to use revise karke badlav announce kiya jayega.
privacy.s9title: 9. Google API Services User Data Policy ka Compliance
privacy.s9body: DROPPER dwara Google APIs se mili information ka use aur transfer, Google API Services User Data Policy ka palan karta hai, jisme Limited Use requirements shamil hain.

guide.metaDesc: Event Dropper kaise use karein: event document (PDF ya image) drop karo, usme se text extract hota hai, aur date-venue apne aap Google Calendar mein aur original file Google Drive mein register ho jaati hai. Screenshots ke saath.
guide.title:
Event Dropper
User Guide
guide.subtitle: Pehli baar use karne walon ke liye
guide.lead: Bas event document drop karo. Event aapke Calendar mein aur file aapke Drive mein — ek hi step mein. Wahi details se WhatsApp/SNS post bhi ban jaata hai.
guide.videoAlt: How-to video for Event Dropper (1:38, Japanese)
guide.videoNote: A how-to video (1:38, in Japanese). It loads the YouTube player only when you press it.
guide.s1body1: Dropper ek web tool hai jo event document (PDF ya image) ko padhta hai, aapke Google Calendar mein event banata hai, aur file ko aapke Google Drive mein save karta hai.
guide.s1body2: Koi installation nahi — yeh aapke browser mein chalta hai. Reading aur registration sab kuch aapke apne Google account ke andar hota hai. Dropper ka koi server nahi hai aur yeh aapka data kabhi store nahi karta.
guide.s2body: Aapko sirf ek Google account chahiye.
guide.st1body: "Sign in with Google" par click karo aur apna account choose karo.
guide.shot2cap: "Sign in with Google" par click karo
guide.st1scopeLead: Google permissions maangega. Dropper sirf yeh teen maangta hai:
guide.st1sc1: Calendar events — tournament event banane ke liye
guide.st1sc2: Dropper dwara banayi gayi Drive files — event document save karne ke liye
guide.st1sc3: App configuration data — aapki settings yaad rakhne ke liye
guide.shot3alt: Google consent screen jismein teen permissions dikhti hain
guide.st2body: Event document PDF ya image ko drop area par drag and drop karo. Aap click karke file bhi choose kar sakte hain.

guide.shot4cap: Drag & drop, ya click karke choose karo
guide.st3body: Tournament name, date, venue, events waghairah apne aap padhe jaate hain aur ek card par dikhte hain. Yahan hamesha results check karo. Jo galat ho use wahin theek kiya jaa sakta hai.
guide.shot5alt: Result card jismein tournament name, date, venue aur events dikhte hain
guide.shot5cap: Results — wahin edit ho sakte hain

guide.shot7alt: Google Drive folder structure: year, month, tournament name
guide.s5body: Behtar reading accuracy ke liye aap AI use kar sakte hain. Yeh poori tarah aapki choice hai. Basic reading iske bina bhi chalti hai.
guide.s5sub1body: Sign in ke baad ek popup poochta hai ki AI use karna hai ya nahi. "Use AI" dabao, bas. Koi API key ya sign-up nahi chahiye (ek person ke liye roz 20 tak).
guide.shot8alt: Popup jo poochta hai ki AI use karna hai ya nahi

guide.s5note1: 📤 Aapki event document file hamare relay (jo kuch save nahi karta) se hokar OpenAI ke AI ko jaati hai. Google Drive se padha gaya text aur calendar ka content kabhi nahi bheja jaata.
guide.s5note2: ⚠️ OpenAI bheja gaya content apna AI behtar karne mein use kar sakta hai (free use ki shart). Personal information wale documents drop na karein.
guide.s5body2: Aapki choice yaad rakhi jaati hai, isliye popup dobara nahi aayega. Ise badalne ke liye, screen ke top par banner mein "AI settings" par click karo.
guide.s6a2: Table tennis aur kuch dusre sports. Screen ke top par sport selector se ek choose karo.
guide.s6a3: Register karne se pehle aap card ko directly edit kar sakte hain. Kuch event document layouts padhne mein mushkil hote hain; AI use karne se aksar madad milti hai.
guide.s6a4: Ise Google Calendar aur Drive se waise hi delete karo jaise normally karte hain. Dropper mein delete function nahi hai.
guide.s6q5: Kya mera data kahin bheja jaata hai?
guide.s6a5: Event Dropper ka apna koi server nahi hai aur yeh kuch save nahi karta. Sirf AI mode use karne par event document file hamare relay (jo kuch save nahi karta) se hokar OpenAI ko jaati hai. Details ke liye privacy policy dekhein.
guide.s7body: Sawaal ya bug reports ke liye, movie.pingpong@gmail.com par contact karein. Yeh ek-vyakti ka project hai, isliye reply mein thoda time lag sakta hai.
privacy.s6n1: Saara communication encrypted connection (HTTPS) par hota hai.
privacy.s6n2: Attendance tool ke alawa teen tools ka data hum store nahi karte, isliye hamare control mein aapka kuch bhi breach ke liye nahi hota. Attendance tool ka data Cloudflare ke platform par surakshit rehta hai.
privacy.s6n3: Settings (jaise AI use karna hai ya nahi) sirf aapke device (browser ke localStorage) mein store hoti hain. AI feature ka relay server bheji gayi files aur AI ke jawab save nahi karta.
privacy.s6n4: Google services tak saari access aapke apne Google account ke authentication aur authorization ke tehat hoti hai.
privacy.s7store1: AI feature use karna hai ya nahi, yeh choice
privacy.s7delLead: Yeh data aap kabhi bhi in tareekon se delete kar sakte hain:
privacy.s7del1: Text recognition (OCR) ke liye temporarily banayi gayi files padhne ke turant baad delete ho jaati hain.
privacy.s7del2: Google Calendar mein banaye gaye events aur Google Drive mein save ki gayi event documents ya schedules aap khud manage karte hain aur kabhi bhi Google se delete kar sakte hain (DROPPER mein delete function nahi hai).
privacy.s7del3: Device par store ki gayi settings ko aap kabhi bhi apne browser settings se delete kar sakte hain.
privacy.s7del4: DROPPER ki aapke Google account tak access ko aap kabhi bhi apni Google Account security settings se revoke kar sakte hain.
privacy.s10body: Is policy mein koi bhi badlav isi page par post kiya jayega. Agar badlav important hoga, to tool ke andar bhi announce kiya jayega.
privacy.s11body: Is policy ke baare mein sawaal ke liye, movie.pingpong@gmail.com par contact karein.
privacy.s11lineTitle: 11. LINE official account version ke baare mein
privacy.s11lineBody: LINE official account "Dropper" chat mein bheji gayi images aur PDFs ko padhkar result wapas deta hai. Sirf is feature ke liye processing hamare server (Google Apps Script) se hoti hai; browser version mein sirf AI feature use karne par bheji gayi files hamare server se jaati hain (section 4). Handling is prakaar hai.
privacy.s11line1: Aapke bheje gaye images ya PDFs hum store nahi karte. Padhne ke liye Google ke Gemini API ko bheje jaate hain aur processing khatam hote hi discard kar diye jaate hain.
privacy.s11line2: Extract kiya gaya content (event ka naam, dates, venue, etc.) bhi store nahi hota. Wo reply mein wapas milta hai aur calendar mein add karne wali link ke andar embed hota hai.
privacy.s11line3: In requests ke liye operator ki apni API key use hoti hai. Free tier mein chalne ke kaaran, per person daily limit rakhi gayi hai.
privacy.s11line4: Usage samajhne ke liye hum sirf date aur time, bheji gayi cheez ka type, result, laga hua time, aur aapke LINE user identifier se bana hashed string (sirf pehle 8 characters) record karte hain. Is string se original identifier wapas nahi nikala ja sakta.
privacy.s11line5: Hum aapki LINE profile information (display name, profile image, phone number, etc.) nahi lete.
privacy.s11line6: Gemini API ko bheja gaya data Google ki policies ke hisaab se handle hota hai. Free tier mein use karne par, bheja gaya content Google ki services behtar banane ke liye use ho sakta hai.
privacy.attTitle: Attendance tool ke baare mein (yeh data hum rakhte hain)
privacy.attBody: Is series mein sirf Attendance tool ka data hamare server par rehta hai. Attendance mein kai log alag-alag devices se likhte hain aur sabko ek hi result dikhta hai, jo sirf browser ke andar mumkin nahi. Baaki teen tools (Event, Schedule, Entry Forms) pehle jaise browser mein hi chalte hain aur hume kuch nahi milta.
privacy.att1: Kya rakhte hain: group ka naam, roster (naam aur gender), event ki details (title, date, venue), replies, aur device pehchanne ke liye ek random id.
privacy.att2: Kya nahi rakhte: email, phone number, address. Reply karne walon ko login ya account nahi chahiye.
privacy.att3: Kahan: Cloudflare D1. Servers Japan ke bahar ho sakte hain, to data bahar transfer ho sakta hai.
privacy.att4: Delete: organiser kabhi bhi admin screen ke "Delete this group" se group, roster, events aur replies sab mita sakta hai. Delete ke baad wapas nahi aata.
privacy.att5: Kitne din: lambe samay tak istemal na hone par, notice dekar data delete kiya jaa sakta hai.
privacy.att6: Kaun kya dekh sakta hai: jiske paas share ki gayi URL (group id) hai, use roster ke naam aur counts dikhte hain. Kisne reply nahi kiya, yeh sirf organiser ki screen par dikhta hai.
privacy.s11analyticsBody: Dropper service improve karne ke liye site usage samajhne hetu yeh tools use karta hai. Yeh site browsing ke statistical information handle karte hain aur aapke Google Calendar ya Drive ke contents (Google user data) se unrelated hain.
privacy.s11a1: Google Analytics: page views aur referrers jaise statistics cookies use karke collect karta hai. Collect ki gayi information anonymized usage statistics hai aur kisi vyakti ko identify nahi karti. Data Google ki Privacy Policy ke according handle hota hai.
privacy.s11a2: Visitor counter (hits.sh): page views ki ginti karke dikhata hai. Yeh cookies use nahi karta.
privacy.s11a3: Agar aap cookies allow nahi karna chahte, to browser settings mein unhe disable karein ya Google Analytics Opt-out Add-on use karein.
privacy.s12body: Is policy ke baare mein sawaal ke liye, movie.pingpong@gmail.com par contact karein.

Schedule Dropper
User guide
gsched.subtitle: Pehli baar use kar rahe hain?
gsched.lead: Ek schedule drop karein. Usme ki saari entries ek saath padh li jaati hain, aap list check karte hain, aur phir sab ek saath Google Calendar mein chali jaati hain.

gsched.s1body1: Yeh ek aisi sheet padhta hai jisme bahut saari dates hoti hain — year planner, fixture list, season calendar — aur un saari entries ko ek saath aapke Google Calendar mein daal deta hai. Dozens entries haath se type karne ki jagah, bas ek baar file drop karein.
gsched.s1body2: Series ke pehle tool Event Dropper se fark itna hai ki ek sheet se kitni entries nikalti hain: Event Dropper ek flyer se ek entry leta hai, Schedule Dropper ek sheet se kai. Dhyan rahe, Schedule Dropper WhatsApp/SNS announcement nahi banata — wo Event Dropper ka feature hai.

gsched.s5sub2: List lambi ho to thodi se shuru karein
gsched.s5sub2body: Dozens entries hon to pehle kuch hi add karke calendar mein dekh lein ki kaisi lag rahi hain, phir baaki add karein. "Sab hatayein" dabaakar shuru se sirf zaroori rows tick kar sakte hain.
gsched.s5sub3body: Jo rows add ho gayin unka tick apne aap hat jaata hai, isliye dobara button dabane par wahi entry do baar nahi jaayegi.
gsched.s5sub4body: List ke upar "Sab chunein", "Sab hatayein" aur "Sirf ⚠ hatayein" se tick ek saath badal sakte hain.
gsched.s6q1: Kya koi bhi schedule padh leta hai?
gsched.s6a1: Nahi. Table jaisi sheet, jisme ek row mein ek entry ho, achhi padhi jaati hai. Poster jaisi zyada design ki hui cheez normal mode mein structure kho deti hai aur padhi nahi jaati. Calendar grid ke liye AI mode use karein.
gsched.s6q2: Year khaali chhod dein to kya hoga?
gsched.s6a2: Agar schedule mein year likha hai to wo apne aap le liya jaata hai. Nahi likha ho to year theek se pata nahi chalta, isliye bhar dena zyada safe hai.
gsched.s6a3: Add karne se pehle list mein hi theek kar sakte hain. Bahut kuch theek karna ho to AI se dobara padhwane par aksar behtar result milta hai.
gsched.s6q4: Wahi schedule dobara drop karne se duplicate ho jaayega?
gsched.s6a4: Jo rows add ho gayin unka tick hat jaata hai, isliye dobara dabane se duplicate nahi hoga. Lekin page reload karke sab shuru se add karenge to ho jaayega — us case mein calendar check kar lein.
gsched.s6a5: Schedule Dropper mein nahi. Announcement Event Dropper ka feature hai.
gsched.s6q6: Mera data kahin bheja jaata hai?
gsched.s6a6: Schedule Dropper ka apna koi server nahi hai aur yeh kuch save nahi karta. Sirf AI mode use karne par schedule file hamare relay (jo kuch save nahi karta) se hokar OpenAI ko jaati hai. Detail ke liye privacy policy dekhein.
gsched.s7body: Tools free hone ke kaaran hum one-on-one support nahi dete. Kuch kaam na kare to is page ke steps dobara dekh lein. Entries chhoot rahi hon to AI mode try karne se aksar result behtar hota hai.
play.bandCatch: Museum band hone ke baad, artworks mein soye spirits jaag uthte hain.
play.bandDesc: Duniya ke chaar museums ki artworks mein se 15 random lagti hain. Jar, talwar, phoolon ki painting — sab mein ek spirit soya hai. Jo chuno usse ek anokha spirit jaagta hai; do-teen chuno to bandhan, aur male card aur female card ka rishta jodo to bachche bhi. Apni photos use nahin hotin. Yeh tool nahin, sirf khel hai.
gattend.metaTitle: Guide | Ek link se attendance jama karein aur ginein (Attendance)
gattend.metaDesc: Dropper Attendance ka guide. Group banayein, roster paste karein, aur ek link baant dein. Members ko na app chahiye, na account, na sign-in - wo roster se apna naam chunte hain aur yes, maybe ya no tap karte hain. Setup se lekar ginti aur officers ke saath share karne tak, sab yahan.
gattend.title:
Attendance
Guide
gattend.subtitle: Yahan se shuru karein
gattend.lead: Practice ya tournament ki attendance ek hi link se jama karein aur ginein. Members ko na app chahiye, na account, na sign-in. Organiser ko bhi Google account nahi chahiye, agar sirf attendance leni hai.
gattend.videoPlay: Play the video from the attendance part (0:48, Japanese)
gattend.videoAlt: How-to video for Event Dropper and Attendance (1:38, Japanese)
gattend.videoNote: Plays from the attendance part (0:48) of a how-to video in Japanese. It loads the YouTube player only when you press it.
gattend.s1body1: Practice, tournament aur doosre events ke jawab jama karke ginne ka web tool. Organiser group banata hai, members ko roster mein daalta hai, aur ek attendance link baant deta hai. Members us link ko kholte hain, roster se apna naam chunte hain, aur yes, maybe ya no tap kar dete hain.
gattend.s1body2: Har group ke liye ek hi link hota hai. Naya event jodne par bhi wo nahi badalta, isliye group chat mein ek baar pin kar dijiye. Baar-baar naya link baantne ki zaroorat nahi.
gattend.s1body3: Series ke chaar tools mein se sirf Attendance mein hum aapka data rakhte hain. Alag-alag device se kai log likhte hain aur sabko ek hi result dikhna hota hai, isliye yeh akele browser ke andar nahi ho sakta. Hum kya rakhte hain aur use kaise delete karna hai, wo privacy policy mein likha hai.
gattend.s1note: Yeh tool abhi preview mein hai. Screens aur steps badal sakte hain.
gattend.s2body: Itna hi chahiye. Na Google account, na kuch install karna.
gattend.s2r1b: Computer ya phone, dono par chalta hai. Kuch install nahi karna.
gattend.s2r2b: Aisa naam jo aapke members pehchaan lein. Baad mein badal sakte hain.
gattend.s2r3b: Jo roster mein jayenge. Spreadsheet se seedha paste kar sakte hain. Gender aur note optional hain, par gender daalne se ginti mein breakdown milta hai.
gattend.s2r4b: Attendance link jaise bhi baantein - group chat, email, ya kaagaz par.
gattend.s2key: 🔑 Organiser ki ek hi chaabi hai: admin link. Na password, na account. Wo link kho gaya to kuch wapas nahi mil sakta. Step 2 use save karne ko kehta hai, aur wo zaroori hai.
gattend.s2safe: Members roster se apna naam chunte hain. Na sign-up, na sign-in. Chuna hua naam us device par yaad rakh liya jata hai, isliye dobara chunna nahi padta.
gattend.st1body: Attendance ka admin screen kholein, “Naya group banayein” ke neeche group ka naam aur members ke naam bharein, aur “Isi se banayein” dabayein. Sirf naam bhi kaafi hai.
gattend.st1note: Spreadsheet ya text file ka roster “≡ List paste karein” se ek saath ja sakta hai. Ek line mein ek aadmi. Gender aur note bhi daal rahe hain to tab ya comma se alag karein.
gattend.st1note2: Ek switch hai: “Members ko bhi dikhayein ki kaun 〇, △ ya × hai”. Use band karne par members ko sirf ginti dikhti hai, gender ke hisaab se. Admin screen par aapko naam dono haalat mein dikhte hain, kyunki team chunne ke liye wo chahiye. Baad mein badal sakte hain.
gattend.st2body: Group ban jaane par admin link sirf ek baar dikhta hai. Wahi aapki chaabi hai, aur screen band karne ke baad dobara kabhi nahi dikhega.
gattend.st2note: ⚠️ Admin link kho gaya to roster aur sabke jawab hamesha ke liye chale jayenge. Chaabi khud hamare server par nahi rakhi jaati, isliye poochne par bhi hum bhej nahi sakte. Screen par “Copy” dabayein aur bookmark ke URL field mein paste karein, ya khud ko message kar dein.
gattend.st2note2: Sirf address bar ko bookmark na karein. Chaabi wala hissa chhoot sakta hai. Hamesha screen ke “Copy” button ka istemal karein.
gattend.st3body: Admin screen par “Event se attendance banayein” ke neeche event add karein. “+ Haath se daalein” se event ka naam, date, last date, jagah aur entries bhar sakte hain. Event ka document ho to use Event Dropper se le aa sakte hain (section 6).
gattend.st3note: Do last date hoti hain. Ek wo jab tak tournament mein entry bhejni hoti hai. Members ko jawab kis din tak dena hai, wo usi se peeche ginkar apne aap tay hota hai - default saat din pehle. Jawab “jawab ki last date” par band hote hain, aur kitne din peeche rakhna hai wo aap badal sakte hain.
gattend.st4title: Attendance shuru karein aur link baantein
gattend.st4body: “Is event ki attendance shuru karein” dabate hi jawab aane lagte hain. Bas attendance link members ko de dijiye.
gattend.st4note: Har group ke liye ek hi link, aur wo kabhi nahi badalta. Group chat mein pin kar dijiye, members jab chahein khol lenge. Naya event jodne par naya link baantna nahi padta.
gattend.st5body: Admin screen ka “Sabke jawab” har entry ki ginti dikhata hai, aur yeh bhi ki kaun yes, maybe ya no hai. Members ne jo baat likhi ho, wo bhi yahin dikhti hai.
gattend.st5note: Jinhone abhi jawab nahi diya, unke naam sirf is admin screen par aur officers wale viewing link par dikhte hain. Members ko kabhi nahi. Kisse jaakar poochna hai, wo yahan se pata chalta hai.
gattend.s4body: Attendance mein teen link hain aur teenon ka kaam alag hai. Kaunsa kisko dena hai, yeh mat gadbadaiye.
gattend.s4r1c: Roster aur jawab badal sakta hai, aur poora group delete bhi kar sakta hai. Kho gaya to wapas nahi milta.
gattend.s4r2c: Jawab dena, apne jawab dekhna, sabke jawab dekhna. Har group ke liye ek, aur badalta nahi.
gattend.s4r3c: Sirf dekhne ke liye. Kaun yes, maybe ya no hai, unki baat, aur kisne jawab nahi diya - sab dikhta hai. Kuch badal nahi sakta.
gattend.s4note: Officers badal jayein to admin screen par “Naya banayein” dabayein - purana viewing link usi waqt band ho jata hai. Officer ko admin link mat dijiye - usse poora group delete ho sakta hai.
gattend.s5body: Mila hua link kholte hi neeche teen tab aa jate hain. Na kuch install karna, na account banana.
gattend.s5sub1body: Pehli baar member roster se apna naam chunta hai aur “Yeh main hoon” dabata hai. Yeh us device par sirf ek baar hota hai. Uske baad khule hue event dikhte hain, aur har entry par yes, maybe ya no chunkar bhej dete hain. “Ek baat (optional)” mein likh sakte hain, jaise “30 minute late aaunga” ya “do gaadi la sakta hoon”.
gattend.s5sub1note: Last date se pehle jitni baar chahein jawab badal sakte hain. Galat dab jaane se kuch bigadta nahi.
gattend.s5sub2body: Us member ne kis event mein kya jawab diya, uski poori list - aur jo abhi baaki hain wo bhi.
gattend.s5sub3body: Har entry ki ginti, gender ke hisaab se. Jin groups mein organiser ne naam dikhane chune hain, wahan yeh bhi dikhta hai ki kaun yes, maybe ya no hai. Jinhone jawab nahi diya, unke naam members ko kabhi nahi dikhte.
gattend.s6title: 6. Event Dropper se attendance shuru karna
gattend.s6body: Event ka document PDF ya photo mein ho to pehle Event Dropper se padhwa lein aur wahin se attendance shuru karein. Event ka naam, date, jagah aur last date sab apne aap aa jate hain.
gattend.s6o1: Event Dropper se document padhwayein aur card dekh lein.
gattend.s6o2: “🙋 Attendance par jayein” dabayein. Admin screen khulega, event pehle se aaya hua.
gattend.s6o3: “Isi se attendance shuru karein” dabayein. Jawab shuru ho jate hain aur aap Event Dropper par wapas aa jate hain.
gattend.s6o4: Attendance link announcement mein aa jata hai, group chat par bhejne ke liye taiyaar.
gattend.s6note: Naye device par pehle admin link paste karke apna group kholein. “Is device par yaad rakhein” dabate hi agli baar paste nahi karna padega. Share kiye ja rahe device par yeh mat karein - us device ko chalane wala koi bhi wahi sab kar sakega jo aap karte hain.
gattend.s6note2: Document ki zaroorat hi nahi hai. Sirf attendance leni ho to pehli screen ke “🙋 Sirf attendance jama karein” se shuru karein.
gattend.s7q1: Kya members ko app install karna padega
gattend.s7a1: Nahi. Wo link browser mein kholte hain. Na account banana hai, na kahin sign-in karna hai.
gattend.s7q2: Kya organiser ko Google account chahiye
gattend.s7a2: Attendance ke liye nahi. Sign-in sirf Event Dropper ki taraf maanga jata hai, jab document padhwate hain ya calendar mein kuch daalte hain.
gattend.s7a3: Maafi chahte hain, wo wapas nahi mil sakta. Chaabi khud hamare server par nahi hoti - hoti, to hum aapka roster aur jawab padh sakte the. Group dobara banayein aur naya link baant dein.
gattend.s7q4: Naye phone par wahi group khul jayega
gattend.s7a4: Haan, agar admin link save kiya hai: admin screen ke “Pehle se group hai?” mein paste kar dein. Agar Event Dropper mein Google se sign-in kiya tha, to chaabi aapki apni Google Drive mein rakhi hai - naye device par sign-in karte hi wapas aa jati hai.
gattend.s7q5: Har event ke liye naya link baantna padega
gattend.s7a5: Nahi. Har group ke liye ek hi attendance link hai aur wo kabhi nahi badalta.
gattend.s7q6: Koi member club chhod de to
gattend.s7a6: “Group ka naam aur members” mein us aadmi ke note mein “left” likhkar save kar dein. Wo roster se hat jayega.
gattend.s7q7: Last date ke baad bhi jawab de sakte hain
gattend.s7a7: Nahi. Jawab “jawab ki last date” par band ho jate hain. Use admin screen ke “Jawab ki last date badlein” se aage-peeche kar sakte hain. Result baad mein bhi dikhta rehta hai.
gattend.s7a8: Admin screen ka “Yeh group delete karein” roster, events aur sabhi jawab hata deta hai. Yeh wapas nahi ho sakta, aur baante hue link khulna band ho jate hain.
gattend.s7a9: Nahi, aur koi ad bhi nahi hai.
gattend.s8body: Tools free hone ke kaaran hum one-on-one support nahi dete. Kuch kaam na kare to is page ke steps ek baar phir dekh lein. Koi member kahe ki link theek nahi hai, to aksar URL ka kuch hissa kat gaya hota hai - admin screen ke “Attendance link” se use dobara copy karke bhej dein.

tool4.name: Entry Form Dropper
tool4.desc: Khali tournament entry form (Excel) drop karein, club roster se players chunein, aur gender, date of birth, age, address aur phone number bhar jaata hai. Roster bhi yahin bana sakte hain, postcode se address ke saath. Japanese entry forms ke liye bana hai (tool sirf Japanese mein hai).
picker.t4line: Entry form, roster se bhara hua
privacy.entTitle: Entry Form Dropper ke baare mein (roster handle karta hai)
privacy.entBody: Entry Form Dropper tournament entry form aur aapke club roster ko handle karta hai, jo personal data hai. Dono sirf aapke browser ke andar process hote hain aur hamare server par kabhi nahin bheje jaate (hamara koi server hi nahin hai). Login ki bhi zaroorat nahin.
privacy.ent1: Kya handle karta hai: entry form (Excel file) aur roster (naam, date of birth, postcode, address, phone number). Bhari hui file bhi aapke hi device par banti hai.
privacy.ent2: Kuch store nahin hota: roster browser mein save nahin hota. Page band karte hi mit jaata hai. Roster apni file ke roop mein rakhein.
privacy.ent3: AI use nahin hota: kaunsi value kis column mein jaayegi, yeh form ke apne headings se tay hota hai.
privacy.ent4: Sirf teen network requests hoti hain, aur unmein se koi bhi aapke daale hue naam, address ya phone number nahin bhejti.
privacy.ent5: (1) Postcode se address aur (2) address se postcode: tool is site par rakhi postcode data files load karta hai (Japan Post ka public data). Woh file load karta hai; aapka type kiya postcode ya address nahin bhejta.
privacy.ent6: (3) Attendance system se group ka naam, naam aur sex import karte waqt: sirf group ID bheja jaata hai. Roster ka content kabhi nahin bheja jaata.
privacy.playTitle: Playground (The Lantern Museum) ke baare mein
privacy.playBody: Playground ka The Lantern Museum (dropper-tools.com/in/play/spirit.html; October 2026 mein "Monster Dropper" aur "Spirit Dropper" se naam badla) museum artworks se spirit cards banane wala khel hai. Aapki apni photos ya files use nahin hotin. Artworks humne The Met, Art Institute of Chicago, Cleveland Museum of Art aur Denmark ki National Gallery ki un works mein se chuni hain jinke rights chhod diye gaye hain (CC0), aur yeh isi site par rakhi hain. Logon ke chehre ya shareer, saaf likhaai ya logo wali works hata di gayi hain. Aap khud sirf "1 in 8 billion" ki life-record image drop kar sakte hain, jo Night Museum ke last door ki key hai (neeche "Kya handle hota hai" dekhein). Login ki zaroorat nahin.
privacy.play1: Kya handle hota hai: artwork images isi site se load hoti hain (museums se connection nahin hota; artwork ke naam par dabane par hi museum ka page khulta hai). Card ki tasveer ke peeche, jis artwork se spirit jaaga woh andhera karke banaya jaata hai, aur artwork image ka ek hissa halke noise ke saath dikhaya jaata hai; yeh card ke saath save hota hai. Aap khud sirf life simulation "1 in 8 billion" (80億分の1) ki life-record image drop kar sakte hain, Light the Night Museum ke last door par (neeche item 7). Koi aur image aapke device par uske layout se pehchaan kar, kuch bhi save kiye bina mana kar di jaati hai. Life-record image se human card banane ke liye, uske life map ke rang (umr, ausat aayu aur har saal ki khushi) aapke device par padhkar card par use kiye jaate hain. Life-record images kisi AI ko nahin bheji jaatin.
privacy.play2: Kya store hota hai: aapke banaye cards (roop, roshni, chhoti picture aur jis artwork se bane uska naam), rishte aur virasat ka record, aur har device ka ek number — sirf aapke device par (browser ke IndexedDB mein). Opening film dekh li hai ya nahin, iska ek nishaan bhi sirf aapke device par (localStorage mein) rehta hai, taaki woh dobara na chale. Drop ki gayi life-record images store nahin hotin. Hum ise dekh nahin sakte.
privacy.play3: Kaise delete karein: page par catalogue khaali karne wala button dabayein, ya browser settings se is site ka data delete karein.
privacy.play5: AI ke baare mein: aapki images kabhi kisi AI ko nahin bheji jaatin (25 October 2026 ko humne life record ka text AI se padhwane wala option hata diya). Sirf jab aap 2 ya 3 museum artworks ka bandhan karte hain, tab un artworks ke number (file names) aur page ki language hamare relay server (Cloudflare Workers) ko bheji jaati hai. Relay server hamare taiyaar kiye artworks ke naam aur background jodkar OpenAI (USA) ke API ko bhejta hai, aur AI bound spirit ka naam aur kahani likhta hai (artwork images ya aapka koi input nahin bheja jaata). API key hum dete hain; aapko key daalne ki zaroorat nahin. Relay server na bheja gaya content save karta hai na AI ka jawab. Apna kharcha ek tay seema mein rakhne ke liye hum OpenAI ka free hissa use karte hain, jo is shart par milta hai ki OpenAI bheja gaya content apne AI ko behtar banane mein use kar sakta hai. Isliye bheja gaya content OpenAI apne AI ko behtar banane mein use kar sakta hai. Iske alawa kuch bhi kahin nahin bheja jaata. Zyada use rokne ke liye, relay server sirf us din ka use aur connection ki jaankari ko chhota karke banaye gaye (wapas na badle ja sakne wale) nishan ke hisaab se ginti rakhta hai, aur agle din mita deta hai.
privacy.play6: Analytics: doosre pages ki tarah, page views Google Analytics (section 12) se gine jaate hain. Saath mein, spirits jaagne, bandhan, rishte aur bachchon ki sirf ginti bheji jaati hai. Images, naam aur card ka content kabhi nahin bheja jaata.
privacy.play7: Light the Night Museum (dropper-tools.com/in/play/night.html; October 2026 mein isne Battle ki jagah li): yeh sirf aapke device par catalogue ke cards padhta hai (unhe badalta nahin). Card ka content kahin nahin bheja jaata. Jab aap last door ki key ke roop mein life-record image drop karte hain, yeh page catalogue page ko ek chhupe frame mein kholkar image deta hai, aapke device par pehchaan kar ek Guardian (human card) catalogue mein jodta hai (upar "Kya handle hota hai" aur "Kya store hota hai" jaisa hi; image kahin nahin bheji jaati aur save nahin hoti). Aapne kitni raatein kheli (kitni baar Dawn ya Quiet Morning aayi), subah mile frames, aur frame kiye har spirit ki copy (naam, rarity, card ki chhoti tasveer, description, aur jis museum artwork se jaaga uska title aur kahani, taaki catalogue khali karne par bhi last corridor mein rahe) sirf aapke device par (browser ke localStorage mein) rehte hain. Catalogue page sirf padhta hai ki kaun se spirits frame hue hain, unhe mark karne ke liye. Browser settings se is site ka data delete karne par mit jaata hai. Analytics ke liye raat shuru karne, last door kholne, Dawn ya Quiet Morning tak pahunchne aur spirit frame karne ki sirf ginti bheji jaati hai.
privacy.ytBody: Kuch guide pages mein YouTube video embed hai. Play button dabane par hi video YouTube (Google) ke privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com) se load hota hai; usse pehle YouTube ko kuch nahi jaata. Dabane ke baad Google ki privacy policy lagu hoti hai.
